headline: FY27 project and admin budgets, plus a revised FY27 full application draft for review and approval.
summary: Financial reports, eligibility materials, and a revised application draft are on the list. Updates cover six projects, including Jones Point and Lawrence School, along with the Historic Commission and the move of CPA pages to the city website.
items: Draft eligibility determination letters (folder with all 20 letters)
Review and approval of revised FY27 full application draft
Fart Alpaca Senior Housing project update
Old business: moving CPA pages to the city website
Old business: in-person meetings, including the first hybrid meeting
location: City Hall Room #6 (Old Tax Collector's Office) and on Zoom
